summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Agriculture to regularly assess cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities within the agriculture and food sector and to conduct annual cross-sector simulation exercises to improve the sector's security and resilience against food-related emergencies.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes an appropriation of $1,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to carry out annual simulation exercises related to food security and cyber resilience. This represents a direct increase in government spending for these specific activities.

The bill authorizes $1 million annually for five years to fund new USDA cybersecurity assessments and simulation exercises. This constitutes new federal spending with no offsetting revenue or cuts, creating a minor increase in the deficit.
